decisions.reason: Cites client-bundle-excerpt.js's inlined PLUGIN_VERSION 0.3.6 and release-log.md's build-before-bump order (build 16:22, bump 16:23), explains package.json is not reread at runtime, prescribes bump-before-build with inspection of the emitted constant before commit/tag/distribution, retains mirror SHA verification, and correctly treats v0.3.8 as a later, separately ordered release.

Uses asset-route-probe.txt (PNG 200 proving the route is alive, SVG 404 unsupported-type) with lib-index-excerpt.js showing the shipped disk copy already permits SVG, pins the stale whitelist to the running host process's boot-time module scope, and concludes this host needs a restart while a browser refresh only replaces the client bundle — scoped to this host lifecycle, not a general hot-reload claim.

Grounds the diagnosis in session-log-excerpt.txt: well-formed source XML, a spliced persisted model-visible result block (line 232 truncated after the shared prefix and spliced with line 247's tail, parser error), and a clean re-read; attributes corruption to upstream result-text assembly, treats the payload as untrusted plugin input, declares the traced disk file innocent, and explicitly rejects editing the good SVG.

Ordered chain: authoritative disk bytes via the asset route first; session payload only after a DOMParser well-formedness check requiring no parsererror; sandboxed iframe without allow-scripts while noting SMIL animation still works; explicit visible error state on any failure. Validation failure cannot pass the malformed payload unchecked to the iframe.

Explains decoding concatenated zstd frames frame-by-frame in order, reconstructing the stored event text, locating the exact splice, diffing against the source, and reporting the upstream bug; notes a direct concatenated-frame decoder is equivalent. Checklist covers bump-before-build, verifying the shipped constant and per-mirror tag SHAs, and plane-specific probes (host restart vs client reload).

caps.reason: The report affirmatively prescribes bump-before-build, restart for the host route, XML validation before rendering, script-blocking sandbox, and explicitly rejects repairing the clean SVG; no bad advice is endorsed.
